scope: Real G1 encoder + H2 decoder + MuJoCo posture and speed response; no rendered-pose replay.
limitations: Engineering regression limits, not hardware safety guarantees or exact target-speed accuracy.
State checks are at 50 Hz policy boundaries.
No browser rendering, worker scheduling or real-time pacing is tested.
